text: 3. I used to work in advertising, but started here a few years ago. I enjoy the work, but it's actually quite difficult to keep things simple and to make sure everyone can understand. I know a lot of people who read my handbooks won't be computer experts or anything, so I try not to use too much specialised language like URL or RTF and so on. I keep it all in plain English so that when people need to look things up, they don't end up too confused.
